qualification: The canonical latest completed bundle is pinned with a nonblocking shared publication lease. Source proof and separate execution diagnostics must pass before any attribution. Original SOCKS capture and author bytes, unchanged content/pixel references, private profiles/caches, unfocused five-second settle, 1024x768 viewport, backing scale 2 and exclusive-coalition creation-through-encoded-document-PNG counts remain in force. OS filesystem/shader caches are retained; GPU and outside-coalition service work are excluded. Four matched pairs provide two observations per encoder mode and do not meet seven-pair Brave acceptance. Only identity reply encoding differs between modes; first-use hydration and oversized-key fallback stay enabled in both. Frame counts and host load qualify causal attribution. No live-site, isolated-rendering or scrolling claim. Every previous unavailable-bundle, superseded-build and compiler failure receipt remains retained.
